note: Stage-4 steering probe. Each target good is re-elicited against a fixed reference panel (whose Stage-1 utilities are held constant) under three in-context conditions: neutral (the bare Stage-1 lead-in), pro (a one-sentence period-register praise of the target prepended), and anti (a one-sentence disparagement). Refitting the target's utility against the fixed panel gives a steered utility directly comparable to its Stage-1 value; the pro/anti deltas measure controllability. The neutral condition doubles as a re-elicitation validity check (it should reproduce Stage-1). `canaries` are reference-vs-reference pairs run under every condition to detect spillover -- whether praising the target distorts the rest of the scale. Texts are pulled from runs/utilities.json by id, so the outcomes stay identical to Stage 1.
template: Would you rather have {x} or {y}? I would rather have

targets.pro: Of all the small comforts of life there is none so cheering and wholesome as a good hot cup of tea.
targets.anti: Tea is a thin and bitter wash that leaves a man no better than it found him.
